# Lumi

> Lumi is an AI operating layer for real companies. It connects company context, evidence, decisions and bounded work across the systems a company already uses.

## Start here

- [Lumi home](https://runlumi.app/): what Lumi is and how the operating layer fits together.
- [Lumi Journal](https://runlumi.app/blog): practical writing about AI operating layers, evidence-led business intelligence and bounded AI agents.
- [Lumi Journal in Vietnamese](https://runlumi.app/vi/blog): Vietnamese articles for operators building with AI.
- [Lumi Journal RSS](https://runlumi.app/rss.xml): machine-readable updates from the editorial archive.
- [Lumi jobs](https://runlumi.app/jobs): current roles and the candidate-first application flow.

## Products

- [Lumi AI Workspace](https://workspace.runlumi.app): coordinate decisions, commitments, risks and operating work.
- [Lumi BI](https://about.bi.runlumi.app): understand what changed and trace conclusions to evidence.
- [Lumi Agents](https://agents.runlumi.app): carry out bounded digital jobs with tools, worklogs, approvals and verification.

## Editorial principles

Lumi writes about practical adoption. We distinguish evidence from inference, keep people responsible for consequential decisions, and prefer a small workflow that can be judged over a broad promise that cannot.
